verdict.rationale: Extend documents official SDKs in Python and TypeScript (plus Java and Go) built for type safety. It also ships a pip package, a quickstart that installs the SDK and parses a document, and SDK polling helpers for async jobs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the SDKs cover the entire API surface (extract, split, classify, workflows), evidence of sensible defaults, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK DX.

support.subject: As a developer, official typed SDKs for Python and TypeScript cover the full API — parse, extract, jobs — with sensible defaults

citations.quote: Extend provides official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go to help you integrate faster and with better type safety.
